propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store_mod, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and siblings to binding_lifecycle.py which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, so the patch no longer reaches those operations.

The test still passes on unmutated code because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the patch's blast radius narrowed and would no longer catch regressions where moved operations unconditionally stamp updated_at.
The integration test's coverage gap is contained because a unit-tier contract test directly pins the no-stamp behavior on binding_lifecycle.clear_absent.
Patching _now_iso on both binding_store_mod and binding_lifecycle restores the oracle's original reach to detect timestamp mutations in moved binding operations.
